story.title: WAV file upload for custom waveform visualization
story.what: Upload a WAV file to visualize how Nyquist-Shannon sampling theorems apply to their own waveform
story.why: To see the theorems demonstrated on real-world audio, not just generated signals
criteria: User can upload a WAV file via the UI
Uploaded waveform is decoded and displayed
Sampling/reconstruction visualizations apply to the uploaded waveform
Invalid files are handled gracefully with clear feedback
